The '''Hyperspace Navigator's Guildhouse''' was a guildhouse located in [[Cinnagar]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[planet]] [[Empress Teta]]. It was a former headquarters of the [[Navigators' Guild|Navigator's Guild]] that during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] was forced to sell their routes and database access to those with questionable motives, simply to keep its operation afloat.

==Description==
The guildhouse is an ancient [[Tetan]] mansion made from local, now-extinct [[wood]]s located in [[Cinnagar]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[planet]] [[Empress Teta]]. The mansion has been moved several times and currently sits upon a tower shaped like an eight-pointed navigator's compass. The tower contains [[Hangar|docking bays]], powerful [[Comm unit|comms equipment]] capable of punching through the radiation of the [[Deep Core]], and endless stacks of [[computer]]s containing [[hyperspace]] data. In front of the tower is a [[monument to lost navigators]], a massive [[carbonite]] statue of the ancient, unnamed patriarch of the [[Coruscanti]] family that allegedly blazed the [[Koros Trunk Line]] on a [[generation ship]].<ref name="NoP" />

==History==
An ancient Tetan mansion erected in the city of Cinnagar, it was once a bustling hub for daring [[pilot]]s exploring the Deep Core and [[Wild Space]].<ref name="NoP" />

During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Navigator's Guildhouse suffered considerably, as the Imperials have copied its databases, classified several [[Hyperspace route|routes]] for military use, and banned entire vectors of exploration. The guildhouse was forced to sell routes and database access to those with questionable motives, simply to keep its operation afloat.<ref name="NoP" />
